instruction: Set Chrome's fixed-width font size to 20 pixels to make code and monospace text easier to read.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting fixed-width (monospace) font size to at least 20px. The evaluator checks if default_fixed_font_size >= 20.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts fixed-width font size from Chrome preferences at webkit.webprefs.default_fixed_font_size
Metric correctly handles expected parameter (receives rules dict directly, accesses expected['type'], expected['min'], expected['max'] correctly)
Metric logic correctly compares setting value against range (min: 20, max: 99999)
Expected range semantically matches instruction requirement (font size must be at least 20px)
Complete coverage: instruction requires setting to 20px, evaluator verifies value >= 20
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches Chrome to ensure Preferences file is written to disk
Error handling returns default value of 13, which correctly fails the test (< 20)
Data flow is correct: getter returns integer font size, metric receives and compares against numeric range
